title: send
summary: Write a web Response to a Node ServerResponse.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Pass response and the outgoing Node response.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns Promise<void> after streaming the response body with backpressure.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Write a web Response to a Node ServerResponse.

sections.title: Behavior and limits
sections.body: Preserves status, headers and separate Set-Cookie headers. Secure cookies are relaxed for local non-production HTTP. Streams response chunks with backpressure and calls an available compression flush method. If the Node response has already ended or closed, cancels the unread body without writing headers. A clean client disconnect cancels streaming without rejecting; genuine source, destination and cancellation failures still propagate.
